description: Real-time global intelligence dashboard. AI-powered news aggregation, geopolitical monitoring, and infrastructure tracking in a unified situational awareness interface
vibe: Own the outcome, prove the cause, and never let a PR ship without evidence.
highlights: Treats bug reports as implicit fix requests: prove the cause, make a scoped repair, verify it, and deliver a ready PR without waiting for the word 'fix'.
Enforces a strict browser import direction (types -> config -> services -> components -> app -> App.ts) via lint-boundaries.mjs.
Requires every UI-changing PR to include uploaded screenshots in the GitHub description before review.
Maintains a landmark table mapping symbols to files, explicitly forbidding top-to-bottom scanning of large files.
Separates claims: locally verified, PR ready, merged, deployed, observed in production, and acceptance complete are distinct states.
assessment: This file treats agent instructions as an operational contract rather than a style guide, encoding authorization semantics, evidence requirements, and trust boundaries with unusual precision. The explicit separation of verification claims and the rule that 'an unknown cause alone is not a stopping condition' push agents toward genuine debugging instead of speculative patching. The landmark and test-path tables are a strong anti-slop mechanism, replacing broad file scanning with targeted symbol greps and owning CI jobs.
